origin: Claude Code 2.1.168: the relay breaks off an answer; the client retries the same request, as its SDK does after a 502, and the relay that may still be generating is not asked again. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and the thinking fields are those Claude Code sends for it (adaptive, effort high). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
